title: New Wagner-affiliated Telegram channel
summary: Channel @afrikanskij_korpus_news created 2024-08-12, accumulated 4,200 subscribers in 36h. Content style and visual identity strongly match prior Wagner media operations. Cross-posts from confirmed Prigozhin-era accounts within first hour of each post.

title: Recurring shell company pattern in Malta filings
summary: Identified 14 Maltese companies registered between 2023-Q4 and 2024-Q2 sharing identical registered address (Tower Road 142, Sliema), single shared director (Anton Borg, b. 1971), and common formation agent. Each holds property exclusively in Larnaca free zone.

title: AIS dark event correlation
summary: Three vessels (ZARIA-7 IMO 9842334, NORD-MARINER IMO 9785612, BRIGHT-DAWN IMO 9901234) have each gone dark for 12-26h windows in the same eastern Mediterranean polygon (35.2N-35.8N, 27.0E-27.6E) on 5 separate occasions in past 60 days. Reappearance courses inconsistent with declared destinations.

title: Crypto wallet linked to ransomware payment
summary: Wallet bc1q7xj4...ka2nsc received 3.2 BTC on 2024-08-13 from a known LockBit affiliate cluster. Funds split within 4h to 11 destination wallets, then through Wasabi mixer. One downstream address matches the cluster from the BlackSpire 2023 incident.

title: Disinformation narrative cluster on EU agriculture policy
summary: Identified 217 accounts on X amplifying a specific anti-CAP narrative since 2024-06-24. Account creation dates cluster Jun 24-Jul 2. Posting times skew to 06:00-09:00 UTC (Moscow business hours). Cross-platform footprint extends to VK and Odnoklassniki where the same narrative appears verbatim 30-90 minutes earlier.
